uncited: This family adapts differentiable volume rendering to non-ideal imaging conditions and multi-modal sensor data by replacing or augmenting the standard emission-absorption model with physics-based signal formation equations [DP-NeRF](8273-dp-nerf.md)[Radar Fields](8904-radar-fields.md).

Both methods optimize implicit scene representations by backpropagating gradients through a modified rendering operator tailored to specific sensor physics [DP-NeRF](8273-dp-nerf.md)[Radar Fields](8904-radar-fields.md).

They replace the standard emission-absorption integration with physics-specific accumulation (rigid motion deformation for optical blur, azimuth-plane summation for SAR) and minimize reconstruction losses against observed multi-view inputs [DP-NeRF](8273-dp-nerf.md)[Radar Fields](8904-radar-fields.md).
